svg.title: DAG for reproductive-health-adjacent covariates, wealth-only SEP
svg.desc: Causal diagram showing how current pregnancy, postpartum status, recent sexual activity, contraceptive use, abortion history, and financial decision-making relate to wealth, cardiometabolic burden, and mental health, classified as measurement confounders, a proxy confounder, a collider, a mediator, or (for financial decision-making) an ambiguous confounder-or-mediator excluded from the primary adjustment set and tested as a sensitivity addition instead. Detail view only — see Figure 1 for the full wealth-burden-mental health skeleton.
